name: SproutAwake
description: SproutAwake is a free iPhone alarm clock for heavy sleepers. Loud alarm sounds and wake-up missions get you out of bed, and 50% of proceeds fund tree planting through One Tree Planted.

features.title: Loud Alarms for Heavy Sleepers
features.description: Alarm sounds engineered to cut through deep sleep. Built for people who sleep through the default iPhone alarm.

features.title: Wake-Up Missions
features.description: Solve a math problem, shake your phone, finish a puzzle, unscramble a word, or find a household object to turn the alarm off. You can't snooze your way out of it.

features.title: Real Trees with One Tree Planted
features.description: 50% of proceeds go to One Tree Planted, a verified reforestation nonprofit active in over 80 countries. Monthly tree-planting updates are posted on TikTok at @sprout.alarm.

features.title: Points, Streaks & Rewards
features.description: Earn points every time you beat your alarm and build streaks for not snoozing. Spend points in the shop on themes, alarm sounds, and animated effects.

features.title: Next-Alarm Widget
features.description: A home screen widget shows your next alarm at a glance, so you never have to wonder whether it's set.

features.title: Rings Through Silent & Focus
features.description: Built on Apple's AlarmKit for iOS 26, so alarms ring through Silent mode, Focus, and Do Not Disturb, just like the built-in Clock app.

faqs.question: What is SproutAwake?
faqs.answer: SproutAwake is an iPhone alarm clock app for heavy sleepers that plants real trees. It uses loud alarm sounds and wake-up missions to make sure you get out of bed, and 50% of its proceeds go to the reforestation nonprofit One Tree Planted. It's made by Newmanship, an indie studio run by developer Ethan Newman.

faqs.question: Is SproutAwake a good alarm for heavy sleepers?
faqs.answer: Yes - it's designed for them. The alarm sounds are engineered to cut through deep sleep, and you can't just tap to dismiss: you have to complete a wake-up mission like a math problem, a puzzle, a word unscramble, shaking your phone, or finding a household object. By the time it's done, you're awake.

faqs.question: How does SproutAwake plant trees?
faqs.answer: 50% of SproutAwake's proceeds are donated to One Tree Planted, a verified reforestation nonprofit that plants trees in over 80 countries. Monthly updates on how many trees have been planted are posted on the SproutAwake TikTok account, @sprout.alarm.

faqs.question: What are wake-up missions?
faqs.answer: Wake-up missions are short tasks you must complete to turn off your alarm: solving a math problem, shaking your phone, finishing a puzzle, unscrambling a word, or finding a household object. They stop you from dismissing the alarm half-asleep and drifting back off.

faqs.question: Will SproutAwake ring when my iPhone is on silent or in Focus mode?
faqs.answer: Yes. SproutAwake uses Apple's AlarmKit (iOS 26 and later), which lets alarms ring through Silent mode, Focus, and Do Not Disturb, just like the built-in Clock app.

faqs.question: Is SproutAwake free?
faqs.answer: SproutAwake is free to download. SproutAwake Pro costs $4.99 per month or $29.99 per year. Optional point packs start at $0.99. Half of all proceeds go to tree planting.

faqs.question: What's included in SproutAwake Pro?
faqs.answer: Pro includes unlimited alarms, all wake-up mission types, and premium themes. It costs $4.99 per month or $29.99 per year, and 50% of it goes to planting real trees.

faqs.question: What devices does SproutAwake work on?
faqs.answer: SproutAwake is available for iPhone and requires iOS 26 or later. It isn't available on Android yet.

faqs.question: How is SproutAwake different from Alarmy and other mission alarm apps?
faqs.answer: Like Alarmy and other mission-based alarm apps, SproutAwake makes you complete a task before the alarm turns off. The difference is what your mornings support: 50% of SproutAwake's proceeds fund tree planting through One Tree Planted, and you earn points and streaks for not snoozing.
